Key features:
• Discover sport, trad and boulder areas from the world map.
• Browse topos and plan your next climbing trip.

• Plan your climbs with a to-do list.
• Create topos of your own.

BROWSE ROCK CLIMBING TOPOS

Hop on the app and find climbing spots near you. Climbers around the world have shared over 30.000 climbing spots on our database. Check out sport, boulder and trad locations, routes, and topos for your climbing trip. Sort routes by difficulty, star rating or popularity to find the best route for you.

FREE TOPOS VS. PREMIUM TOPOS

Start using 27 Crags for free. Anyone (including you) can create and publish a Free rock climbing topo. Free topos are open for anyone to browse and edit up to 20 routes. On the other hand, this means that the information is not always up to date.

Premium topos are made by people who know the region very well and are committed to keeping the information up to date. With the help of local climbers, 27 Crags experts evaluate Premium topo quality every time before making it available for you.

PREMIUM SUPPORTS THE CLIMBING COMMUNITY

Subscribe to Premium and get the best and most accurate info for your climbing destination, straight into your pocket. Every time you browse Premium topos, you support the team who created them. We share 50% of our subscription profits with the climbers who create Premium topos.

Premium is available as a monthly or a yearly plan – for as little as the price of two cups of coffee a month. You can unsubscribe from Premium whenever you want.

CREATE YOUR OWN CLIMBING TOPO

Want to add your home crag or update an existing one? Add crags, upload images, draw lines and add route information. Share your knowledge with the climbing community. 

EARN WITH PREMIUM CLIMBING TOPOS

27 Crags is the only climbing app that rewards topo developers. We share 50% of our profit with climbers who create new Premium topos, so we can give back to the climbing community.

Cash out or donate to access or bolt funds. Get paid for doing what you love.

Tedy jak a kdy hraje, jakou má formu, na jakém místě v tabulce se nachází, nebo kdo je nejproduktivnějším hráčem týmu. Každý fanda si může vybrat, zda bude chtít sledovat veškeré extraligové dění, nebo zda si v možnostech vybere pouze svůj oblíbený tým. V aplikaci nechybí nejzajímavější články webu hokej.cz, stejně jako super videa důležitých událostí utkání. Ať už se jedná o góly, zákroky, hity nebo bitky. Samozřejmostí je rozpis již odehraných, ale také budoucích zápasů, včetně informací, jaký televizní kanál bude dané utkání vysílat.
